notes.title: We're so back update 03/08/25
notes.content:
Sorry guys for no update for god knows how long my real life situation has been abit of a emotional rollercoaster, I'll be honest I don't even remember what's actually been done in this update since I've been just silently spending like a few minutes on conviction for the past few months but I know three things I've done at least (I am the greatest game developer ever)

-Fixed brightness slider
-Buffed Gatling damage
-Fixed enemy AI pathfinding and remapped all AI navigation in levels (for the last time I hope)

notes.title: 26.10.24 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Okay its been abit since the games been updated what was suppose to be a one month break turned into quite along time back were back and full of energy to finish the job to celebrate this ([i]I totally wasn't playing the game and realised how bad it was before updating it[/i]) were releasing a semi big update to just give the game abit more polish and for things to come so lets go through what's been added/ changed

NEW:
-New enemy models (not all enemies are done quite yet but the main guys are done rest will be updated soon!)
-New enemy animations
-New pickup UI
-Improved textures
-Added a Dodge and Crouch mechanic (Shift to dodge and Control to crouch)
-Minor level design improvements 

Gonna try and pump out another update before the month ends to just tweak and add some more polish thank you for your patience!

notes.content:
Mini update nothing special, new graphics and new Amalgamation boss fight its not yet finished but should give you a idea how the fight is gonna turn out later down the road just haven't had time due to my real life job not giving me enough time to work on conviction.

Thank you for your patience stay tuned for more updates.

notes.title: Upcoming Content Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone first of I'd like to thank everyone who picked up conviction during the steam summer sale it really means a lot now lets get down to business!

Hopefully by the end of the month I'll be able to release a major content update for conviction, its mostly just a revamp of existing textures, new additional models for levels to help levels not all feel the same and have more depth along with a complete overhaul of the first boss on level 5!

Thank you guys for you continued support and I look forward to updating you guys more on future content related to conviction!

notes.title: Update notes for 11th June
notes.content: Nothing special just updated the background of the main menu and added a new level and a new enemy type in the level too hoping the rest of Chapter 2 will be ready by the end of the month!

notes.title: Lighting update
notes.content: Scaled up brightness so you can actually see in levels.

notes.title: General Content Update!
notes.content:
Hi guys really sorry for lack of communication on my end unfortunately I was not able to get all of chapter 2 done last month due to my real life job taking up my time and other responsibilities in the mean time I've decided to update the game with what I've done so far and hoping this month chapter 2 will be nice and the game will just feel more polished in general anyway lets talk about what's been done!

NEW ADDITIONS:

- 2 NEW LEVEL

- NEW WEAPON (The Gatling)

- VISUAL OVERHAUL (Still more to come!)

- GENERAL FIXES


That's right we've added two brand new levels for you to try out with access to the newest weapon in your arsenal the Gatling gun!

On top of that I've started a visual overhaul for the game and the new textures really make the game pop out more!

notes.title: Weapon Pickups update
notes.content: another quick short and sweet update levels 2 and 4 now have pickups for the revolver and shotgun makes alot more sense then just being in your inventory from the get go. (I'm pretty sure most people don't even know they had guns at this point so hopefully this clears some confusion)

notes.title: Minor map fixes
notes.content: Minor map fixes here and there in various levels, mostly game breaking out of bounds related stuff

notes.title: Chapter 2 Announcement + General Visuals Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone just wanted to leave a quick announcement post that Chapter 2 of Conviction is almost done and should be released around the end of April!

The chapter will include:
- 5 New playable levels
- 2 New enemy variants
- 2 New weapons

Aside from this I'm currently working on updating the visuals of the game with some nice fancy textures here and there since the game is looking abit flat I've also taken the time to learn to animate in blender so I plan on working on making new enemy attack animations etc.

Thank you for your time I look forward to everyone enjoying Chapter 2 of Conviction!

notes.title: Secret level + general announcements
notes.content:
Hi guys very excited to announce the release of a secret playable level in conviction, to access the level you will need to find the button in the "level select" screen in the menu, good luck to finding it!

And also as a general announcement conviction is officially 1/3 finished now, the plan right now is to launch 2-3 levels in batches now for returning players, in the mean time I will be throwing smaller updates out such as bug fixes, enemy/ weapon redesigns etc.

Thank you guys for your patience and time and enjoying Convcition.

notes.title: NEW REVAMPED LEVELS 4 + 5
notes.content:
Hi guys very excited to announce the new levels 4 and 5 worked really hard on them so I hope you enjoy them the, boss on level 5 is still a work in progress but its a lot better then walking around collecting 3 keys then fighting just a bigger version of a normal enemy if I say so myself ontop of that I've fixed a few issues regarding level 3. 

Now that first 5 levels have been revamped I plan on just polishing what's already in the game now to make conviction the best it can be I wanna thank everyone whose given me feedback and reporting bugs without you conviction would most likely be in a much worse state then it is now.

additionally to polishing I'm gonna start working on a secret level that you'll be able to unlock, I'm very excited to make this secret level as its more of a experimental idea level to try new ideas etc so stay tuned!

notes.title: Prep update for major update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, got a very exciting update today as this update is mostly laying the foundation for a more refined conviction experience for the first major update hopefully at the end of the month!

But lets take a look at what been added / changed:

- Swapped out save game system for a level select instead

- Improved AI pathing and collisions for both enemies and the player

- Revamped level 3 abit mostly cause I wasn't happy with some parts of it

- In-game FPS toggle in settings (will only be available from levels 1-3 since 4-5 will be getting changed out soon)

- Keybind weapon switching using numpad buttons (Will implement key bind switching soon, but for now this should be better then just scrolling a wheel to switch)

Thank you guys for reading, hopefully the next update will be out by the end of the month.

Start to Mid February:

Thank you for your time and I hope you enjoy the rest of your day, evening or night!

notes.title: CHANGING TO EARLY ACCESS AND OTHER FIXES
notes.content:
Hi guys sorry for the lack of radio silence pretty much to sum everything up to where I've been...RETAIL HELL its not a very nice place ANYWAY! That's not what were here to talk about, so right now I've made the decision to close the beta soon and instead make the game early access, reason why is cause I'm not really happy with how the game has been (mostly level wise wow the levels are really bad haha) so it makes more sense to be early access then a demo.

On top of that I've been paying for help with code and music, to help refine the game more whilst I slave away in retail and they've been extremely helpful and I'm extremely grateful for it. we've managed to fix a lot of bugs that have been issues for awhile now and adding new stuff to make the overall workflow quicker and easier.

For those who have also been updating the demo version and actually playing the game you will have noticed noticeable improvements thru-out each update we hope to keep this up with new levels with what were currently planning since a lot of the levels how they are now are just very bland and all look the same so I'm working hard to make some interesting level designs.

Honestly thank you guys for enjoying and wishlisting my game, I plan on adding a lot more features to the game soon currently just wanna fix/improve what is currently there so we have a sturdy foundation to build upon thank you for your time!

notes.title: Demo Release + Future Plans
notes.content:
Hello gamers and thank you for checking out the [b]Conviction Demo[/b], I've been made aware that there's a few bugs and other issues currently plaguing the overall experience of the game and I plan on working on that as soon as possible. I'm taking as much criticism as I can to improve the overall experience to make a [b]HOPEFULLY[/b] awesome game, also for those who are unaware the demo is pretty much a early access version of the game so I plan on revamping and improving a lot of things in the game for a smoother experience!

In the meantime there's not really to much to say on my end aside that I'm gonna work on creating social media accounts so I can boost the amount of people seeing my game and get more criticism other then that I'm extremely grateful to everyone who has supported me getting to this stage and I hope I can meet your expectations of my game when the full release comes out.
